svg.text: Calgary Transit GTFS schedules, fall 2016, 2019 and 2026. Scheduled service, not observed.
One reference Tue, Fri, Sat and Sun per year. Week = 4 × Mon–Thu + Fri + Sat + Sun.
First to last stop of each trip, apportioned to clock hours. 10% deadhead on all service.
A route-hour counts if it averages 6+ trips per hour per direction (3-hour smoothing).
Counted at 2.5× bus hours. The result holds between 2× and 3×.
School specials (routes 600–899). This measures supply, not ridership.
